item.title: BBC World Service Announces AI Feature Available for One Day
item.description:
BBC World Service Announces AI Feature Available for One Day

On 5 September 2026, the BBC World Service’s latest five‑minute news bulletin announced an AI‑related feature that will be available for a single day. Additional episodes are listed on the programme website.

📅 Overview

  • Announcement date: 5 September 2026
  • Source: The latest five‑minute news bulletin from BBC World Service

⚙️ Availability

  • The AI feature is available for 1 day only.

🔗 Access

  • Further episodes can be explored via the programme website.
  • Users are invited to see more episodes for additional content.

#BBC #AI #NewsBulletin #Release

Source: BBC Audio | BBC News | 05/09/2026 04:01 GMT
